statement: DSMIL uses an instance stream and a bag stream linked to the highest-scoring instance.
does_not_establish: No demonstrated advantage on SMC rejection.
method_or_result: Dual-stream MIL with contrastive patch representations.

statement: HIPT uses two self-supervised hierarchy levels and evaluates slide-level cancer tasks.
does_not_establish: No proven optimal magnification or benefit for cardiac biopsies.

statement: DTFD-MIL introduces pseudo-bags and double-tier learning to address small WSI cohorts.
supports: A bag-learning strategy to test under identical splits.
does_not_establish: No increased independent clinical sample size or SMC validation.

statement: TCGA site signatures remained detectable after common color interventions and biased model evaluation.
supports: Acquisition source can carry target-correlated shortcuts.
does_not_establish: No proof of shortcut magnitude or causal mechanism in SMC.

statement: Virchow was evaluated for specimen-level cancer detection across common and rare cancer groups.
does_not_establish: No validated performance for SMC ACR/AMR or non-H&E stains.
method_or_result: Virchow patch encoder with downstream aggregation.

statement: The authors found miscalibration in modern classifiers and evaluated temperature scaling as a post-hoc remedy.
does_not_establish: No evidence that SMC ensemble probabilities are calibrated or clinically useful.
method_or_result: Comparison of post-hoc probability calibration methods.

statement: MADELEINE uses multistain views with global and local alignment for slide representation pretraining.
does_not_establish: No established gain from our stain presence mask or event classifier.

statement: The graph-fusion framework combines nonregistered H&E and trichrome representations, including late concatenation.
supports: A concrete multistain fusion design without pixel correspondence.
does_not_establish: No gain established for cardiac H&E/IHC event-level MIL.
method_or_result: CNN-GNN stain branches with graph fusion.

statement: CARE distinguishes conventional grade-associated morphology from morphology associated with clinically evident rejection.
supports: Histologic grade and clinical severity are distinct prediction targets.
does_not_establish: No proof our pathology-label model predicts future rejection or clinical benefit.

statement: DSMIL Fig. 2 pairs 5x context with spatially corresponding 20x patches by concatenating their features.
supports: Distinguish spatial feature fusion from averaging independent scale probabilities.
does_not_establish: No validation of unaligned magnification fusion in SMC.
